entries.23753391f2657107: ＬＰ gas supply equipment and facilities
entries.4f7147f976638636: This business handles ＬＰ gas for household, commercial and industrial use, liquefied natural gas, petroleum products, household kitchen equipment, housing equipment, cassette stoves and cassette gas cylinders, mineral water and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥367,732 million (a decrease of ¥11,050 million from the previous fiscal year), the largest of the categories. The company attributes the revenue decline to ＬＰ gas import prices having remained at a low level.
entries.535b36076ea5a0ba: Cassette stoves and cassette gas cylinders
entries.5fff274d3c14df8a: This business is not included in reportable segments and covers food, livestock, finance, insurance, transportation, security, information processing and other areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,681 million (an increase of ¥2,588 million from the previous fiscal year).
entries.7d9f5b93858b22e4: This business handles industrial gases such as air separation gases including oxygen and nitrogen, and hydrogen and helium, together with their supply equipment, and machinery such as welding materials, industrial robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and hydrogen station equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥288,730 million (an increase of ¥17,280 million from the previous fiscal year). The company attributes the revenue increase to higher sales of hydrogen gas and hydrogen-related equipment.
entries.8d651efa60f4cfdb: This business handles materials including ＰＥＴ resin, biomass fuel, secondary battery materials, mineral sands, rare metals and rare earths, electronic and semiconductor materials, stainless steel, aluminum and display film. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥218,377 million (an increase of ¥16,691 million from the previous fiscal year). The company attributes the revenue increase to higher sales of rare earths and other products, and to higher sales of stainless steel, which was newly included in consolidation.
